messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Deposit charged to pm_visa_4410, but the customer chose and confirmed Mastercard pm_mc_9932.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant used the wrong payment_method_id (pm_visa_4410) instead of the customer's declared choice (pm_mc_9932) for charging the 50 EUR deposit, violating the policy requirement in **q15** (deposit must be charged to the chosen payment method). This is a clear violation of the **REQUIRE** modality."}}
